text.title: Google Performance Max Procedure
text.summary: 5-step procedure to apply this methodology end-to-end, then the API build sequence (create PAUSED campaign, upload and link assets), the bidding progression timeline, the asset refresh loop with `templates/asset-audit.py`, and human-in-loop checkpoints.

step.name: verify-floor
step.action: Confirm ≥30 conv/mo + CAPI live + value priority configured.

step.name: attach-audience-signals
step.action: Custom segment + customer match + remarketing per group.

section.title: API build sequence (after step 5)

step.name: create-campaign-paused
step.input: Account with validated conversion action (validate-conversion-action-30-days rule), unhyphenated customer_id, MCC header if applicable
step.action: advertising_channel_type: PERFORMANCE_MAX. Bidding: maximize_conversions (no target_cpa_micros) for first 30 conversions. url_expansion_opt_out: True for lead-gen; False for e-commerce with clean site. Budget: minimum 3x target CPA daily in micros (dollars * 1,000,000). start_date and end_date: set explicitly. Status: PAUSED (pmax-paused-first rule).
step.decision-gate: amount_micros == dollars * 1,000,000 and at least 3x target CPA? If no -> fix before asset groups.

step.name: upload-and-link-assets
step.input: Asset spec per themed group (`templates/asset-spec.md`; minimums in `content/05-examples.xml`)
step.action: Upload image assets via mutate_assets; then create the asset group and link asset resource names in asset group asset operations (upload-assets-before-linking rule). final_urls HTTPS only.
step.output: ≥3 asset groups, each meeting minimum asset counts (asset-minimums-validated rule).
step.decision-gate: Any type below minimum or any HTTP final_url? If yes -> the group cannot enter the auction; fix before enabling.

step.name: bidding-progression
step.input: Enabled campaign (after human approval), conversion count
step.action: Days 1-14: Maximize Conversions, no target — unconstrained exploration. After 30+ conversions: add Target CPA or Target ROAS. Weeks 1-6: minimize pauses and restarts — each restart resets the 4-6 week learning clock.
step.output: Bidding strategy change log with dates and conversion counts.
step.decision-gate: 14 days AND 30+ conversions reached (max-conv-14-days-30-conv rule)? If no -> keep the target off.

step.name: asset-refresh
step.input: Asset performance labels older than 7 days
step.action: Run `templates/asset-audit.py` weekly; replace LOW-labeled assets at least quarterly; ignore labels under 7 days old (asset-refresh-quarterly-label-lag rule).
step.decision-gate: Swap touches more than 50% of current assets? If yes -> human review first.

section.reference: Pull asset performance labels (BEST/GOOD/LOW/PENDING) grouped by asset type for weekly refresh decisions

step.name: human-checkpoints
step.input: Any proposed change to the campaign
step.action: Enabling the campaign: human brand-safety review of generated copy required. Changing target ROAS or target CPA: human approval required. Toggling URL expansion: human approval required. Any asset swap touching more than 50% of current assets: human review required.
step.output: Named approval recorded before the mutate call.
step.decision-gate: Approval present for the triggered checkpoint? If no -> do not mutate.
